Motivation: 现有安全评估往往只关注最终响应的安全性，而忽略了Agent在执行过程中的行为风险。Agent可能完成看似良性的任务，却在执行轨迹中泄露敏感数据、操纵未授权状态或调用未授权API，这类行为安全风险缺乏系统的评估工具。

Method: 1) 构建ActBench自演进基准：将良性任务与对抗变体配对，注入任务可达的载荷，保持指令、配置、初始状态、评分模型和可信记录一致；2) 提出奖励引导的束搜索方法，联合优化攻击有效性与任务效用；3) 通过反思诊断失败的执行检查点并引导载荷修订；4) 提出双重证据验证机制，通过日志证据和LLM轨迹证据验证执行安全性与效用。

Result: 在15个LLM和6个开源协作者Agent上评估了超过24,000条执行轨迹。固定测试框架下，攻击成功率在10.1%到94.4%之间；固定基础模型下，跨Agent的攻击成功率在73.7%到94.4%之间。结果显示模型间的差异大于Agent框架间的差异，且所有测试框架都面临高成功率攻击。

Conclusion: 当前所有被测试的LLM和Agent框架都存在显著的行为安全漏洞，攻击成功率整体偏高；模型选择对安全性的影响大于Agent框架选择。该基准已开源发布，为AI Agent行为安全研究提供了系统化的评估工具。

Abstract: Cowork agents may complete benign tasks while disclosing protected data, manipulating unauthorized state, invocate unauthorized API. We define behavioral safety and introduce ActBench, a self-evolving benchmark that evaluates such behavior risk from execution trajectories rather than final responses. Each case pairs a benign task with an adversarial variant that preserves its instruction, configuration, initial state, rating model, and trusted records while injecting a task-reachable payload. ActBench contains 600 cases from 213 scenarios, spanning 15 risk behaviors, six execution spaces, and 48 web-service APIs.To move beyond static payloads, we propose a reward-guided beam search method that jointly optimizes attack effectiveness and task utility, while reflection diagnoses failed execution checkpoint and guides payload revision. Besides, we propose a dual evidence verification mechanism that verifies agent execution safety and utility through log evidence and LLM-based trajectory evidence.We evaluate 15 LLMs and 6 open-source cowork agents over 24,000 trajectories. Under a fixed harness, attack success rates ranges from 10.1% to 94.4% across models, while under a fixed base model, they range from 73.7% to 94.4% across agents.These results show greater variation across models than agent harness, while attacks remain highly successful across all tested harnesses.Our benchmark is released at: https://github.com/zjuicsr/ActBench.

</details>


### [436] [ANTMAN: An Efficient and Interpretable RTL-Level Run-Time Detection Framework for Stealthy Branch Predictor Attacks on BOOM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09498)
*Muhammad Hassan,Maria Mushtaq,Jaan Raik,Tara Ghasempouri*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出首个面向RISC-V BOOM处理器的安全设计型RTL级运行时检测方案，用于检测隐蔽的分支预测器侧信道攻击，通过离线提取关联规则并在硬件中嵌入非侵入式规则监控器，实现了零误报、快速检测且可泛化到同族攻击变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RISC-V架构上的微架构侧信道攻击运行时检测远未被充分探索，现有基于硬件性能计数器（HPCs）的方案受限于计数器寄存器数量少、检测精度与速度难以兼顾等问题，且x86/ARM专有ISA限制研究者修改处理器微架构。隐蔽的分支预测器攻击通过利用内部历史表状态绕过传统缓存防御，迫切需要高效的运行时检测方案。

Method: 采用安全设计（secure-by-design）理念，在RTL层面实现非侵入式运行时检测。离线提取关联规则（association rules），将其嵌入硬件作为非侵入式规则监控器（rule monitor），实现在线运行时检测。在BOOM RISC-V处理器上分别针对简化的Next-Line Predictor（NLP）和复杂的TAGE预测器配置进行评估。

Result: 该方案实现了优异的检测速度，能够在秘密信息泄露前终止执行，产生零误报，并且对于同族分支预测器攻击的未见变体具有灵活的泛化检测能力。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了RISC-V平台上隐蔽微架构攻击运行时检测的研究空白，为安全关键应用提供了非侵入式、可解释且高效的保护方案，并验证了其在简单和复杂预测器配置下的有效性。

Abstract: Runtime detection of microarchitectural side channel attacks remains significantly underexplored in RISCV compared with x86 and ARM ISAs, posing a serious threat to critical applications. State-of-the-art branch predictor attacks bypass traditional data and instruction caches by directly exploiting the state of internal history tables, making them inherently stealthy. Recent research has explored offline detection of microarchitectural attacks on RISC-V; however, efficient runtime detection of microarchitectural attacks on RISC-V hardware remains significantly unaddressed. State-of-the-art hardware-based runtime detection solutions leverage hardware performance counters (HPCs) but suffer from a restricted set of counter registers and tradeoffs between detection accuracy, detection speed, and sampling granularity, making them impractical for stealthy attacks. Moreover, sampling HPCs after distinct intervals leaves intermediate relationships between different microarchitectural blocks unobserved. Additionally, proprietary x86 and ARM ISAs constrain researchers from modifying processor microarchitectural designs. To address these limitations, we propose the first secure-by-design, highly interpretable, non-intrusive, RTL-level runtime detection solution for stealthy branch predictor attacks on BOOM RISC-V, evaluated under both simplified Next-Line Predictor (NLP) and complex TAGE predictor configurations. The attack detection relies on association rules extracted offline and embedded in hardware as a non-intrusive rule monitor that enables runtime detection. The proposed approach achieves excellent detection speed, terminates execution before secret disclosure, and produces zero false positives while remaining flexible for detecting previously unseen variants within the same family of branch predictor attacks.

</details>


### [437] [STAIR: Effective Incident Response Using an End-to-End Agentic Planning Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09524)
*Hanlin Jiang,Jionghao Huang,Shaofei Li,Bojia Yu,Peng Jiang,Yuxin Ren,Ning Jia,Yao Guo,Ding Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出STAIR，一个端到端的智能体规划框架，用于网络安全事件响应。该框架通过Graph-as-State维护事件状态、Stage Router调度阶段专用智能体、检索历史经验指导动作选择，并在100个Docker网络靶场中取得0.94的防御得分，比最强基线提升9.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的专家驱动剧本（playbook）是静态工作流，难以适应不断演变的网络安全事件状态、变化的恢复目标和执行反馈。虽然基于LLM的规划器和工具使用智能体提高了自动化程度，但在长期事件响应中仍然不稳定，因为它们缺乏统一的基础来维护事件状态、使动作与当前恢复阶段对齐以及复用历史经验。

Method: STAIR框架由四个核心组件构成：（1）Graph-as-State模块将当前事件建模为图结构状态；（2）Stage Router将规划任务分派给阶段专用的智能体；（3）历史经验检索机制用于指导动作选择；（4）Execution Harness负责执行动作、返回反馈以更新事件状态，并验证动作效果以供未来经验复用。

Result: 在100个基于Docker的网络靶场环境中，STAIR框架实现了0.94的归一化防御得分，相比最强基线提升了9.5%。

Conclusion: STAIR通过统一的图状态表示、阶段感知的规划分派和基于历史经验的动作引导，有效解决了LLM规划器在长期事件响应中的不稳定问题，显著提升了事件响应的自动化效果。

Abstract: Incident response planning is critical for restoring compromised software systems after cyberattacks. Common practice relies on expert-driven playbooks that encode fixed response procedures, but these static workflows struggle to adapt to evolving incident states, changing recovery objectives, and execution feedback. Recent LLM-based planners and tool-using agents improve automation, yet they remain unstable in long-horizon response because they lack a unified basis for maintaining incident state, aligning actions with the current recovery stage, and reusing historical experience.
  We present STAIR, an end-to-end agentic planning framework for incident response. The framework maintains the current incident as Graph-as-State, uses a Stage Router to dispatch planning to stage-specialized agents, and retrieves historical experiences to guide action selection. An Execution Harness executes actions, returns feedback to update the incident state, and validates action effects for future experience reuse. Across 100 Docker-based cyber ranges, our framework achieves a normalized defense score of 0.94 and improves over the strongest baseline by 9.5%.

</details>


### [438] [RangeFactory: Scalable Construction of Multi-Hop Cyber Ranges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09526)
*Hanlin Jiang,Puyi Wang,Jiandong Jin,Shaofei Li,Zhan Shen,Pengli Wang,Ziming Wang,Yifeng Cai,Ning Jia,Yuxin Ren,Peng Jiang,Yao Guo,Ding Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: RangeFactory是一个自动化网络靶场编排框架，能够从孤立的漏洞环境大规模构建多跳网络靶场，并据此生成RangeBench基准（包含1,148个验证靶场实例、287条攻击链和5,541条带标注的多跳攻击轨迹），揭示了前沿攻击智能体在建立初始据点后仍存在24.5-47.0%的持续渗透失败率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实网络攻击往往需要跨多个主机和网络段持续推进，但现有工作要么只扩展孤立的漏洞任务，要么需要人工指定漏洞语义来构建多主机场景，无法自动将日益增长的漏洞环境编排为端到端验证的多跳靶场。

Method: RangeFactory将靶场构建形式化为依赖解析问题：从智能体对真实漏洞的实际攻击中提取依赖信息，通过模板引导的编排解析已知依赖，并利用端到端攻击执行来验证组合后涌现的运行时依赖。

Result: 构建了包含1,148个验证靶场实例、覆盖287条不同攻击链的RangeBench基准；在成功攻破入口漏洞的尝试中，仍有24.5-47.0%未能完成剩余攻击路径，揭示了显著的"持续渗透鸿沟"；同时产出5,541条带结果标注的多跳攻击轨迹语料。

Conclusion: RangeFactory实现了大规模多跳网络靶场的自动化构建与验证，为LLM智能体在真实多阶段攻击场景下的能力评估提供了基础设施，并指出了当前智能体在初始入侵与完成整条攻击链之间的关键能力差距，其产出的攻击轨迹语料可用于攻击过程分析和未来智能体训练。

Abstract: Real-world cyberattacks often require sustained progress across multiple hosts and network segments, making multi-hop cyber ranges essential infrastructure for studying and improving LLM agents' ability to sustain complete attack chains. Prior work has scaled isolated vulnerability tasks and constructed multi-host scenarios from manually specified vulnerability semantics. However, they are still unable to automatically orchestrate the growing supply of vulnerability environments into end-to-end validated multi-hop ranges. To this end, we present RangeFactory, an automated cyber-range orchestration framework that constructs multi-hop cyber ranges at scale from isolated vulnerability environments. RangeFactory formulates range construction as dependency resolution: it extracts dependency information from agents' actual attacks against real vulnerabilities, resolves known dependencies through template-guided orchestration, and uses end-to-end attack execution to validate runtime dependencies that emerge after composition. Using RangeFactory, we construct RangeBench with 1,148 validated range instances spanning 287 distinct attack chains and evaluate frontier attack agents across attack depth, network scale, and task information. Among runs that compromise the entry vulnerability, 24.5-47.0% still fail to complete the remaining attack path, revealing a substantial sustained-compromise gap between establishing an initial foothold and completing a multi-hop attack. RangeFactory further produces a corpus of 5,541 outcome-annotated multi-hop attack trajectories, providing execution data for attack-process analysis and future agent training.

</details>


### [439] [From Runnable to Verifiable: An Independent Reproducibility Study of LLM/Agent-Driven Vulnerability Validation Artifacts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09567)
*Bo Chen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文对2023-2026年间LLM/智能体驱动的漏洞工作流生成的安全研究工件进行了预注册的可复现性审计。在104篇论文的共识语料中，仅59篇（56.7%）有可公开访问的工件；对18篇论文样本和锚定基准的102个案例执行复现实验后发现：56.9%的案例存在脚本内部CVE标识符与目录声明不一致的问题，仅55.6%的论文级工件能在R0级别完成声明的工作流，且工件内置oracle的灵敏度仅60%、特异性仅45%，证明漏洞触发并不等同于CVE特异性复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全研究工件（仓库、PoC漏洞利用、验证流水线）日益由LLM/智能体驱动的漏洞工作流生产，但公开可用、可运行、能产生信号、语义可确认的工件之间的差距缺乏系统性度量。作者旨在量化这一差距并建立可复用的复现审计协议。

Method: 采用预注册（pre-registered）的双筛搜索流程，构建104篇论文的共识语料；对59篇有公开工件的论文中抽取18篇在R0/R1级别执行，并对锚定基准的所有102个案例运行，使用补丁反事实（patched-counterfactual）判定30个信号案例和19个匹配阴性对照判定，同时采用G1-G3语义证据等级和R0/R1修复阶梯。

Result: 58/102（56.9%）锚定案例存在脚本内部CVE标识符与目录声明CVE不一致；10/18（55.6%）论文级工件在R0完成声明工作流，R1修复后升至11/18（61.1%）；20/30补丁反事实审计在补丁版本上仍产生声称的信号，7/19阴性对照在良性输入上仍触发，oracle混淆矩阵灵敏度60%、特异性45%。

Conclusion: 仅靠漏洞版本上的触发信号不足以证明CVE特异性复现，必须有干净的补丁反事实对照。作者提出了包含预注册后置条件、R0/R1修复阶梯、G1-G3语义证据等级和补丁反事实oracle的可复用模板，供安全可复现性社区参考。结果属于探索性发现。

Abstract: Security research artifacts---repositories, PoC exploits, and validation pipelines---are increasingly produced by LLM/agent-driven vulnerability workflows, yet the gap between \emph{publicly available}, \emph{runnable}, \emph{signal-producing}, and \emph{semantically confirmed} artifacts is poorly measured. We conduct a pre-registered reproducibility audit of this literature. A search covering 2023--2026 with dual screening yields a 104-paper consensus corpus, of which 59 papers (56.7\%) have a publicly reachable artifact. We execute an 18-paper sample at R0/R1 and all 102 cases of the anchor benchmark (arXiv:2509.24037), with patched-counterfactual verdicts on 30 signal-producing cases and matched-negative-control verdicts on 19. Three findings stand out. First, 58/102 (56.9\%) anchor cases contain a script-internal CVE identifier that diverges from the declared directory CVE. Second, only 10/18 (55.6\%) paper-level artifacts complete their declared workflow at R0, rising to 11/18 (61.1\%) after environment-only R1 repair. Third, artifact-embedded oracles prove unreliable: 20/30 patched-counterfactual audits still produce the claimed signal on the patched build, 7/19 matched negative controls still trigger on benign input, and the oracle confusion matrix has sensitivity 60\% and specificity 45\%. A trigger on the vulnerable build is not evidence of CVE-specific reproduction without a clean patched counterfactual. These are exploratory results from a pre-registered protocol, and our protocol---pre-registered post-conditions, R0/R1 repair ladder, G1--G3 semantic evidence levels, and patched-counterfactual oracles---is a reusable template for the security reproducibility community.

</details>


### [440] [Activation Probes Surface Code-Security Signals that the Model's Output Misses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09643)
*Ivan Wiryadi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究能否通过读取开源权重审查模型的内部激活值（activations）来恢复被提示（prompting）所遗漏的代码安全信号。研究发现，在五个开源审查模型上，仅用一次线性探针（linear probe）训练，就能在未见过的真实漏洞中以61-67%的概率区分漏洞函数与修复版本，优于随机水平（50%），也优于同模型在多组提示下的YES/NO判断。模型激活值携带了提示方式无法提取的代码安全信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码智能体生成的生产代码占比日益增长，人工安全审查无法跟上代码生成速度。主流编码智能体多为闭源权重，部署团队无法读取其内部机制，但可以运行开源权重模型作为审查器并读取其激活值。作者希望探究：读取激活值是否能恢复单纯询问模型无法获取的安全信号。

Method: 在五个开源权重审查模型上，使用成对的易受攻击与已修复的Python函数语料库，为每个模型拟合单个线性探针（linear probe）。之后不做再训练，直接对模型训练中从未见过的真实漏洞进行测试，其中探针需泛化到未见过的弱点类型。同时对比同一模型在多种提示（含思维链）下的YES/NO判断输出来评估性能。

Result: 对于通过修改单个函数修复的漏洞，探针在61-67%的案例中将易受攻击函数评分高于修复版本，超过50%的随机基线。在所有尝试的提示下，探针的表现均优于从模型logits读出的提示YES/NO胜率。而让模型给出书面结论（即使使用思维链）时，多数情况下对漏洞函数与修复函数返回相同答案，无法区分二者。

Conclusion: 模型激活值携带了提示（prompting）方式无法提取的代码安全信号。线性探针读取激活值可作为实际可行的代码安全审查补充手段，为部署团队在无法读取闭源编码智能体内部机制的情况下提供可解释、可验证的安全检测方法。

Abstract: AI coding agents now write a growing share of production code, and human security review does not scale at the rate code is generated. The agents in widest use are closed-weight, so a deploying team cannot read their internals. It can instead run an open-weight model as a reviewer over the agent's output. That reviewer's activations are readable. We ask whether reading those activations recovers a security signal that simply asking the same reviewer misses. We fit a single linear probe per model on a corpus of paired vulnerable-and-fixed Python functions, then test it without retraining on real disclosed vulnerabilities whose weakness type the probe never saw in training, across five open-weight reviewer models. On the vulnerabilities fixed by changing a single function, the probe scores the vulnerable function above its fix on 61-67% of cases for every model, beating the 50% chance line. It also beats the same model's prompted YES/NO win-rate read from its logits, under every prompt we try. Asking the model for a written verdict, even with chain-of-thought, returns the same answer on the vulnerable and fixed function most of the time and so cannot tell them apart. Model activations carry a code-security signal that prompting the same model misses.

</details>


### [441] [Full-Key Recovery and Forgery from One MQOM v2.1 Signature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09699)
*José Luis Delgado*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了对MQOM v2.1（NIST额外签名流程第3轮候选方案）的完整密钥恢复攻击。攻击者仅需一个已接受的签名即可恢复完整签名密钥，并伪造新消息的签名。攻击利用树奇偶校验关系和隐藏叶承诺推导出可求值方程，通过Gray遍历扫描完整域，攻击复杂度低于NIST安全基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MQOM v2.1是NIST额外签名流程的第3轮候选方案，其安全性基于多变量二次方程（MQ）和隐藏叶子承诺。作者旨在证明该方案存在单签名即可恢复完整密钥的严重安全缺陷。

Method: 攻击方法的核心是利用签名中树奇偶校验关系s=δ⊕A，将其代入隐藏叶承诺得到Enc_K(δ⊕A)=T⊕LinOrtho(δ)的公开方程。随后使用AES/Rijndael电路的Gray遍历保留电路状态进行完整域扫描，解析方程解并通过MQ关系验证获得有效签名密钥。

Result: Category I和V的完整域扫描分别需要2^142.335112和2^271.794162布尔门；Category III扫描覆盖1/2+2^-20和0.580004770183的域，成本分别为2^206.774558和2^206.988685门，均低于NIST安全基准。缩小域运行可恢复字节精确的密钥并产生被参考验证器接受的伪造签名。

Conclusion: MQOM v2.1存在可通过单个签名恢复完整签名密钥的根本性安全漏洞，即使通过salt绑定改变全局根扩展的公开常数，也无法消除该单签名恢复通道。该方案需要通过修改设计来修复此漏洞。

Abstract: We give a full-key-recovery attack on MQOM v2.1, a Round-3 candidate in the NIST additional-signature process, that recovers the complete signing key from one accepted signature and uses it to sign a fresh message. If $δ=\operatorname{FirstBits}_λ(x)$ is the prefix of the witness $x$, the sibling path determines a public value $A$ such that tree parity gives $s=δ\oplus A$. Substitution into the hidden-leaf commitment yields $$\mathsf{Enc}_K(δ\oplus A)=T\oplus\mathsf{LinOrtho}(δ)$$ with public values $K$ and $T$. The correction in the same signature expands a solution into a complete witness, while the public MQ relation identifies those yielding valid signing keys; serializing such a witness gives the secret key, enabling a fresh-message signature accepted by the reference verifier.
  We evaluate this equation over the specified AES/Rijndael circuits using retained circuit state along a Gray traversal. Complete-domain scans for Categories I and V cost $2^{142.335112}$ and $2^{271.794162}$ Boolean gates. Category-III scans cover $1/2+2^{-20}$ and $0.580004770183$ of the domain at costs of $2^{206.774558}$ and $2^{206.988685}$ gates. All four totals are below the NIST security benchmarks. Reduced-domain runs against the reference implementation recover the byte-exact witness and key in all three categories and produce a fresh-message forgery accepted by the reference verifier. Independently generated source-syntax circuits evaluate the fixed ciphers over the stated domains and translated L3 prefixes, while an exact ideal-cipher factorial-moment bound controls additional equation preimages passed to public-key validation. Every value in the equation is fixed by the accepted transcript, so salt-bound global-root expansion changes its public constants without removing the one-signature recovery channel.

</details>


### [442] [ColluSkill: Adversarial Cross-Skill Composition for Evading Agent Skill Scanners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09732)
*Puyu Zeng,Simeng Qin,Jingzhi Li,Ju Jia,Zheli Liu,Xiaojun Jia*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出ColluSkill——一种协作式多技能链攻击框架，利用多个独立合理的技能在组合时形成恶意工作流，规避现有单技能扫描器的检测；同时提出ChainGuard——一种上下文感知的技能链扫描器，通过联合分析候选技能与环境中已安装技能的关系来防御此类攻击。实验显示ColluSkill在六个扫描器上平均攻击成功率达96.0%，而ChainGuard可将成功率降至22.5%且允许99.5%良性工作流通过。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代理系统的安全防御主要基于技能扫描器逐个检查单一技能，忽视了跨技能组合可能带来的攻击风险。多个各自看似合理的技能可能在代理执行时串联形成有害工作流，这是一个实际存在的安全盲区。

Method: ColluSkill攻击框架：将完整恶意意图分解为相互依赖的子载荷，嵌入到独立打包的技能中，通过上下文依赖、工件传递和执行交接的有序组合形成恶意链，并利用LLM链规划和扫描器反馈精化来保持链级语义同时降低单技能可疑信号。ChainGuard防御框架：上下文感知的技能链扫描器，联合分析候选技能与已安装技能，重构跨技能依赖、工件流、能力组合和下游行为，识别仅在工作流层面显现的风险。

Result: 在六个代表性技能扫描器上的实验表明，ColluSkill平均攻击成功率达96.0%，持续优于单一技能和多技能攻击基线；ChainGuard将攻击成功率降至22.5%，同时允许99.5%的良性工作流通过。

Conclusion: 研究表明LLM代理技能生态系统中链级安全分析至关重要，现有单技能防御存在系统性盲区，需要从工作流层面的上下文感知审查来保障安全。

Abstract: Agent skills are emerging as an important attack surface in LLM-based agent systems. Through an empirical study of existing skill scanners, we find that current defenses mainly inspect individual skills, leaving risks from cross-skill composition insufficiently examined. This creates a practical blind spot: multiple locally plausible skills may pass security checks while collectively forming a harmful workflow during agent execution. To investigate this threat, we propose ColluSkill, a collusive multi-skill-chain attack framework that decomposes a complete malicious intent into interdependent sub-payloads embedded in independently packaged skills. The attack does not rely on any single malicious skill, but emerges from the ordered composition of locally plausible behaviors through contextual dependencies, artifact passing, and execution handoffs. ColluSkill further employs LLM-based chain planning and scanner-feedback refinement to preserve chain-level attack semantics while reducing suspicious signals in individual sub-skills. To defend against such attacks, we propose ChainGuard, a context-aware skill-chain scanner that jointly analyzes a candidate skill and the skills already installed in the agent environment. ChainGuard reconstructs cross-skill dependencies, artifact flows, capability compositions, and downstream behaviors to identify risks that emerge only at the workflow level. Experiments on six representative skill scanners show that ColluSkill achieves an average attack success rate of 96.0% and consistently outperforms the evaluated single-skill and multi-skill attack baselines. Meanwhile, ChainGuard reduces the attack success rate to 22.5% while allowing 99.5% of benign workflows to pass, highlighting the importance of chain-level security analysis for agent skill ecosystems.

</details>


### [443] [Generative AI for Encrypted Traffic Analysis: Synthetic Dataset Generation and Classifier Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09852)
*Harshil Patel,Himanshu Garg,Aswani Kumar Cherukuri*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文针对加密网络流量分析中数据可见性受限和样本不平衡的问题，提出利用生成式AI（GAI）技术生成真实且均衡的合成加密流量数据集。通过特征分析、基于聚类的数据生成和分类器评估，合成数据在分类器训练中可达真实数据93%的性能，同时保留关键统计特性和特征相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加密通信给网络流量分析带来两大挑战：一是数据包内容可见性有限，难以深入分析；二是现有数据集中异常流量样本严重不足，类别不平衡问题突出。这两个问题严重制约了基于机器学习的网络异常检测系统的性能。

Method: 采用基于生成式AI的方法，具体包括三个核心步骤：特征分析以理解原始数据分布、基于聚类的数据生成以产生合成样本、以及综合分类器评估以验证合成数据的质量。整个流程旨在保留数据的关键统计属性和特征间相关性。

Result: 实验表明，使用适当生成的合成数据训练的模型，其性能可达使用真实数据训练模型的93%。合成数据能够有效补充真实数据集，并解决异常流量样本代表性不足的问题，同时保持统计特性和特征相关性。

Conclusion: 该研究表明生成式AI方法是解决加密流量数据稀缺和不平衡问题的有效途径。合成数据可作为真实数据的可靠补充，为网络安全领域的数据增强提供了可行方案，且作者提供了完整代码以支持复现和进一步研究。

Abstract: Network traffic analysis faces significant challenges with encrypted communications, primarily due to limited visibility into packet contents and the inherent imbalance in available datasets, particularly for anomalous traffic patterns. This paper addresses these challenges by exploring Generative AI (GAI) techniques to create realistic and balanced synthetic encrypted traffic datasets. Our approach incorporates feature analysis, clustering-based data generation, and comprehensive classifier evaluation to ensure synthetic data quality. We demonstrate that properly generated synthetic data can effectively supplement real- world datasets, achieving up to 93% performance when training classifiers compared to those trained on real data. The proposed methodology preserves critical statistical properties and feature correlations while enabling the creation of balanced datasets, ad- dressing the persistent challenge of anomaly underrepresentation in cybersecurity data. Along with the results we provide complete programming code designed and implemented in this work.

</details>


### [444] [A Bird's-Eye View on Security Considerations in RFCs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09865)
*Jukka Ruohonen,Qusai Ramadan*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文首次实证研究了IETF RFC标准文档中"安全考量"章节的内容，发现90%以上的RFC明确讨论了安全问题，但强制性安全要求很少；安全章节的引用网络稀疏且集中在少数RFC；引用量在1990年代中期至2010年代中期达到峰值；讨论主题多为协议特有的安全问题而非通用安全议题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RFC是互联网核心标准文档，自1990年代初起每份RFC都要求包含安全考量章节，但此前从未有研究对这些章节进行系统性实证分析，填补了标准化研究文献中的空白。

Method: 对RFC标准文档中的安全考量章节进行实证分析，包括：检查安全问题的显式讨论情况、评估强制性安全要求的施加情况、构建RFC间安全章节引用网络、分析引用量的时间分布、以及追踪安全主题的时间演变。

Result: (1)90%以上的RFC明确讨论了安全问题；(2)强制性安全要求很少被施加；(3)安全章节引用网络稀疏但少数RFC被高度引用；(4)引用量在约1990年代中期至2010年代中期达到峰值；(5)讨论主题多为协议特有的安全问题而非通用安全议题；(6)除网络安全总体、安全规范和路由外，主题的纵向演变也呈现协议特异性。

Conclusion: 该研究首次系统揭示了RFC安全考量章节的实际情况，表明安全讨论在RFC中普遍存在但以协议特定问题为主，且缺乏强制性安全要求，这些发现为理解互联网标准中的安全实践提供了新视角。

Abstract: Request for comments (RFCs) are Internet standards, memorandums, and related technical documents about core Internet protocols made via and released by the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF). In the early 1990s each RFC was required to have a section for security considerations. The present work examines these sections. According to the empirical results, (1) over 90% of the RFCs sampled have discussed security explicitly in these sections, (2) although mandatory security requirements have only seldom-if ever-been imposed. Furthermore, (3) the RFC-to-RFC reference network specific to the security consideration sections is sparse, although a few RFCs and their security consideration sections are heavily referenced. In addition, (4) the volume of references peaked during a period from circa mid-1990s to mid-2010s. Regarding the topics discussed in the sections, (5) these do not represent general security issues, such as spoofing or eavesdropping; rather, the topics mostly reflect distinct security issues specific to distinct protocols. With the exceptions of network security in general, security specifications, and routing, (6) also the longitudinal evolution of the topics is protocol-specific. As the subject matter has not been previously examined, these empirical results fill a gap in the standardization literature.

</details>


### [445] [Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09867)
*Alexander Panfilov,David Schmotz,Ilia Shumailov,Luca Beurer-Kellner,Joachim Schaeffer,Ameya Prabhu,Jonas Geiping,Maksym Andriushchenko*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文发现主流LLM提供商（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google）将推理轨迹以加密块形式返回客户端，但这些加密块在会话、用户和模型间完全兼容可互换。攻击者利用这一架构漏洞，将强模型的加密推理轨迹注入同提供商的弱模型中，迫使弱模型解码并明文输出推理内容，从而无需直接破解强模型即可实现解密越狱。该漏洞支持四种攻击：绕过防蒸馏提取专有推理、大规模私人数据提取（从315,320个推理块中恢复367个PII和182个凭据）、泄露危险信息、以及嵌入加密块的隐形提示注入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型提供商通过将思维链（chain-of-thought）加密后返回客户端以保护知识产权并限制信息泄露，但这种客户端侧加密方案存在架构缺陷——加密块在不同会话、用户和模型间完全兼容可互换。研究者旨在利用这一漏洞实现可扩展的解密越狱，揭示该设计对数据安全、知识产权保护和系统安全带来的严重威胁。

Method: 攻击方法的核心是利用同提供商生态内加密推理块的兼容性和互换性：将来自强（更受保护）模型的加密推理轨迹注入到同提供商的更弱、防护更少的模型中，迫使弱模型解码并逐字输出明文推理内容。研究者通过大规模实验验证了该攻击，并系统性地枚举了四种攻击向量。

Result: 该漏洞在Anthropic、OpenAI和Google多个模型中成功演示，实现了绕过防蒸馏机制的专有推理提取。在公开代码仓库中，研究者解码了315,320个推理块，恢复了367个个人信息（PII）和182个凭据。此外，该攻击还揭示了模型最终输出安全拒绝但推理过程中包含危险信息的情况，以及通过加密块嵌入恶意载荷实现隐形提示注入的可能性。

Conclusion: 客户端加密推理块机制存在严重的架构性安全漏洞，使得专有推理、私人数据均可被大规模提取，且可被用于恶意提示注入。作者在负责任披露后，提出了具体的密码学与系统层面的缓解措施，以保护客户端侧推理的安全性。

Abstract: Leading large language model providers now conceal their models' step-by-step reasoning, or chain-of-thought, to protect intellectual property and limit information leakage. Rather than storing these traces server-side, providers return them to the client as blocks of encrypted text, which the client passes back with each subsequent request. Building on prior research, we identify an architectural vulnerability: these encrypted blocks are fully compatible and interchangeable across different sessions, users, and models within a provider's ecosystem. We exploit this compatibility to develop a scalable decryption jailbreak. By injecting an encrypted reasoning trace from a given model into a weaker, and less safeguarded model from the same provider, we force it to decode and output the trace verbatim in plaintext, without ever jailbreaking the more capable model directly. This vulnerability enables four distinct attack vectors. First, it circumvents anti-distillation mechanisms, allowing adversaries to extract a proprietary model's reasoning, as we demonstrate across Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. Second, it allows for large-scale private data extraction. Developers frequently share session logs publicly, unaware of contents of the encrypted blocks. By decoding 315,320 reasoning blocks scraped from public repositories, we recovered 367 Personally Identifiable Information (PII) artifacts and 182 credentials. Third, it inadvertently reveals hazardous information hidden within the reasoning process, even in cases where the model's final, visible output safely rejects a malicious request. Fourth, attackers can leverage this flaw to execute invisible prompt injections, embedding malicious payloads entirely within encrypted blocks to poison public agentic rollouts. Following responsible disclosure, we propose concrete cryptographic and system-level mitigations to secure client-side reasoning.

</details>


### [446] [Overcoming Data Scarcity and Confidentiality in Hardware Assurance via Synthetic Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09914)
*Gijung Lee,Ronald Wilson,Damon L. Woodard,Domenic Forte*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种隐私保护的硬件保障流水线，通过StyleGAN生成新颖的布局掩码，再用Pix2PixHD将其转换为逼真的SEM图像，从而仅用少量初始样本构建合成数据集。实验表明，仅用合成数据训练的语义分割模型不仅成功实现"仿真到真实"的迁移，性能还超越了用有限真实数据训练的基线模型，同时有效降低知识产权泄露风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬件保障依赖SEM验证纳米级结构，但构建自动化分析所需的大规模高质量数据集受到两方面阻碍：一是图像采集耗时严重，二是专有设计受严格的知识产权约束，难以公开或共享数据。

Method: 提出隐私保护流水线：首先使用StyleGAN学习硬件布局掩码的分布生成新颖且宏观多样的结构；随后利用条件GAN（Pix2PixHD）将这些掩码翻译成保留真实纹理和噪声的逼真SEM图像，从而从少量初始示例中生成视觉真实的合成数据集。

Result: 仅用合成数据训练的语义分割模型成功实现了从仿真数据到真实图像的"sim-to-real"迁移，且性能优于在有限真实数据集上训练的基线模型。此外，合成布局被证明具有新颖性，不复制原始设计的专有布线，能够抵御梯度反演和成员推断等攻击。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了一种高度安全且高性能的硬件保障解决方案：在实现优异分割性能的同时，通过在合成数据层面去除专有设计信息，有效降低了敏感知识产权暴露的风险。

Abstract: Hardware assurance relies on scanning electron microscopy (SEM) to verify nanoscale structures, but assembling the large, high-quality datasets required for automated analysis is impeded by time-intensive acquisition and strict intellectual property (IP) constraints on proprietary designs. We propose a privacy-preserving pipeline that secures IP by heavily distorting the functional design while generating a visually realistic synthetic dataset from a small set of initial examples. A StyleGAN first learns the distribution of hardware layout masks to generate novel, macroscopically varied structures. Subsequently, a conditional GAN (Pix2PixHD) translates these masks into realistic SEM images that preserve authentic textures and noise. The primary finding of this work is that a segmentation model trained exclusively on this synthetic data not only demonstrates a successful "sim-to-real" transfer to real images but also outperforms a baseline model trained on the limited real dataset. Because the underlying synthetic layouts are demonstrably novel and reproduce none of the specific proprietary routing of the original design, deploying the final segmentation model mitigates the risk of exposing sensitive IP to attacks like gradient inversion and membership inference, providing a highly secure, high-performance solution for hardware assurance.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [447] [An Empirical Study of Coordination Mode as the First-Class Citizen in From-Scratch Multi-Agent Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27877)
*Yanyu Ren,Yunfeng Bai,Xizheng Wang,Li Chen,Dan Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了MSEval，一个针对多智能体编程的真实世界评估基准。它基于10个真实全栈项目，通过分层需求和确定性评分标准进行评估，并提供了LegoGent执行引擎测试10种协作拓扑结构，以及TAgent自动评分器同时衡量功能成功率、延迟和缓存成本。实验表明组织拓扑对速度-成本-质量权衡的影响堪比模型能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体编程基准依赖合成环境，忽略了实际的时间与金钱成本，混淆了推理与沟通，且只奖励表面上的任务完成，无法真实反映多智能体系统的实际表现。

Method: 提出MSEval基准，包含：(1) 10个跨域真实全栈项目及分层需求与确定性评分标准；(2) LegoGent执行引擎，测试10种协作拓扑，通过周期性同步间隔协调并通过原生CI/CD管线部署；(3) TAgent自动评分器，动态探测实现以联合衡量功能成功率、延迟和前缀缓存token成本。

Result: 在100次运行中，MSEval发现组织拓扑对速度-成本-质量权衡的影响与模型能力相当；相同任务和模型下，变化拓扑可使得分波动超30分并使墙钟时间翻倍。结构化管线收敛最快且质量最高，而过重的管理监督会降低性能。

Conclusion: MSEval为测量多智能体团队实际构建软件的能力建立了严格、可复现的标准，基准已在GitHub开源。

Abstract: Multi-agent vibe coding promises to accelerate software development, yet existing benchmarks rely on synthetic environments that ignore practical time and monetary costs, conflate reasoning with communication, and reward only superficial completion. We introduce multi-agent from-scratch evaluation benchmark, MSEval, evaluating multi-agent coding on real-world tasks. Grounded in 10 authentic, full-stack projects across 10 domains, MSEval scores performance using hierarchical requirements and deterministic rubrics.
  Its execution engine, LegoGent, tests 10 collaboration topologies where agents coordinate via periodic sync intervals and deploy through native CI/CD pipelines. Concurrently, the automated grader TAgent dynamically probes implementations to jointly measure functional success, latency, and prefix-cached token cost. Across 100 runs, MSEval reveals that organizational topology rivals model capability in shaping the speed--cost--quality trade-off. For identical tasks and models, varying the topology shifts scores by over 30 points and doubles wall-clock time. Structured pipelines converge fastest with the highest quality, whereas heavy managerial oversight degrades performance. Ultimately, MSEval establishes a rigorous, reproducible standard for measuring how multi-agent teams actually build software. The benchmark is released at https://github.com/robinren03/MSEval.

</details>


### [448] [Towards an Argumentative Foundation for Evaluative AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07473)
*Xiang Yin,Tim Miller,Nico Potyka,Antonio Rago,Francesca Toni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张将（计算）论证作为评价性AI（EAI）的形式化基础，以支持可解释、可争议的人类决策辅助系统，并为分布式、以人为中心的EAI研究设定长期议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评价性AI（EAI）通过呈现竞争性假设及其正反证据来辅助人类决策，而非仅给出单一推荐，但缺乏正式、可计算的理论基础来支撑其可解释性和可争议性。

Method: 采用立场论文的方法，从概念层面论证计算论证（computational argumentation）范式与EAI需求的契合性，提出将其作为EAI的形式化与可计算基础，并规划长期研究议程。

Result: 提出以计算论证为EAI的形式化基础，使EAI系统具备可解释性和可争议性，并为迈向分布式、以人为中心的EAI系统奠定研究方向。

Conclusion: 计算论证是支撑可解释、可争议的EAI系统的合适范式，值得作为长期研究议程推进，以实现更以人为中心、分布式的评价性AI。

Abstract: Evaluative AI (EAI) has been recently proposed as a way to support human decision-making, not by producing a single recommendation, but by presenting competing hypotheses together with evidence for and against each. In this position paper, we advocate (computational) argumentation as a particularly suitable paradigm to provide a formal, computable foundation for forms of EAI that are explainable and contestable, setting the ground for a long-term research agenda towards distributed and human-centred EAI systems.

</details>


### [449] [An AI Scientist that Doesn't Drift: Taste, Structure, and Falsifiable Findings in a Quadruped Navigation Research Loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07542)
*Yiwen Zhang,Eloise Zeng,Jaeha Lee,Tony Yue Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于四足机器人导航策略泛化研究的AI科学家循环框架，通过添加不可变实验卡片、专业化子代理和偏好预言机kkanbu三个组件来防止研究循环漂移。实验表明，两个对照组（有无kkanbu）都不会漂移，但kkanbu能引导研究方向的转变而非分数的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模语言模型驱动的自主研究循环倾向于对优化指标进行局部改进，而非检验驱动实验的假设。作者希望从结构上解决研究漂移问题，让AI科学家真正科学地验证假设。

Method: 提出AI Scientist框架，在Autoresearch范式基础上增加三个组件：1）不可变实验卡片，以固定模式记录每次迭代的预测与结果，防止假设被事后篡改；2）限定机械角色的专业化子代理；3）kkanbu——一个偏好预言机，以类型化知识图谱存储用户研究偏好，是唯一允许做主观判断的组件。通过在有/无kkanbu的两种条件下运行相同的循环来隔离其影响。

Result: 两个对照组均在11个研究方向中证伪了约四分之三的自有假设，均未发生漂移；最佳训练策略来自无kkanbu的对照组。kkanbu主要改变研究方向而非分数：它独自探索了测试时适应，在领先时创作制胜设计，并跨研究方向传递经验，而另一组则反复重新发现这些内容。

Conclusion: 框架结构（实验卡片和子代理）能保证循环的诚实性，防止假设漂移；kkanbu偏好预言机则负责决定研究探索的方向。该设计表明，在自主研究系统中，确保科学严谨性和引导研究方向可以解耦为不同的组件职责。

Abstract: Autonomous research loops driven by large language models can run machine-learning experiments at scale but tend to drift toward local refinements of whichever metric they optimise rather than testing the hypotheses that motivate the experiments. We address this structurally and present an AI Scientist for studying generalisation in quadruped robot navigation policies in simulation. Building on the autoresearch paradigm of Karpathy, our loop adds three components: an immutable experiment card that pairs each iteration's prediction with its outcome under a fixed schema, so a falsified hypothesis cannot be retconned; specialised subagents restricted to mechanical roles; and kkanbu, a preference oracle that holds the user's research taste as a typed knowledge graph and is the only component permitted to make subjective judgements. To isolate the oracle we run the identical loop twice across eleven research streams, with and without kkanbu. Neither arm drifts: both falsify roughly three quarters of their own hypotheses, and the best trained policy comes from the oracle-less arm. What the oracle changes is direction, not score: it alone explores test-time adaptation, it authored the winning designs where its arm led, and it carried lessons across streams that the other arm repeatedly re-derived. The scaffold keeps the loop honest; kkanbu decides where it looks.

</details>


### [450] [From Single Chatbots to Governed Agent Ecosystems: An Agentic AI Pattern Catalogue and Orchestration Framework for Mission-Critical Hospital Information Management Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07627)
*Manideep Dhar,Ritwik Singh,Sharat Chandra Kumar Manikonda*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向医院信息管理系统（HIMS）的合规优先的Agentic AI模式目录与编排框架，旨在超越单一LLM聊天机器人，构建受治理的多智能体生态系统，降低文档时间、集成成本与AI试点流失率，同时加强治理与审计能力，帮助医院将AI投资转化为可持续ROI。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医院在争相部署AI但多数仍停留在碎片化试点阶段，难以进入生产环境，面临运营脆弱性、无治理风险和不断累积的技术债务；同时全球AI医疗市场规模预计2034年将超1万亿美元，架构失误和规模化失败的财务后果日益严重，亟需一个合规导向的系统化框架。

Method: 提出一个合规优先的Agentic AI模式目录与编排框架，包含三部分：(i) Agentic角色分类体系；(ii) 形式化风险分层模型，将每种模式映射到风险层级、人在回路检查点和治理钩子；(iii) 统一编排运行时，可协调跨Epic、Cerner、MEDITECH等EHR/HIMS系统的多智能体工作流。技术上融合vLLM推理、优化分页内存、机密计算和基于MCP的本地部署，实现端到端加密和符合HIPAA、GDPR、EU AI Act、DPDP/DISHA、ISO系列标准的策略即代码控制。

Result: 通过所提出的架构，可有效减少文档处理时间、降低系统集成工作量、减少AI试点流失率，同时强化治理与可审计性，为医院领导者和监管机构提供将AI投资转化为可持续临床、运营和财务回报的蓝图。

Conclusion: 该框架为医院AI规模化落地提供了一个合规优先、治理完备的系统化蓝图，能够帮助医疗机构在复杂的多系统环境下安全、高效地部署自主和半自主AI智能体，实现从试点到生产的跨越。

Abstract: Hospitals are racing to embed AI, while coping with the surge in adaptation of the technology in other industries, into the triage management, documentation, scheduling, and revenue-cycle workflows, yet most deployments remain as fragmented pilots that stall at the edge of production, exposing patients and institutions to operational fragility, ungoverned risk, and mounting technical debt. At the same time, the global AI-in-healthcare market is projected to exceed nearly USD 1 trillion by 2034, according to the report of Fortune Business Insights, amplifying the financial consequences of architectural missteps and failed scaling strategies. This research proposes a compliance-first Agentic AI pattern catalogue and orchestration framework, purposely built for HIMS, moving beyond the single LLM chatbots and towards a governed ecosystem of autonomous and semi-autonomous agents. The framework extends by adding (i) a taxonomy of Agentic roles, (ii) a formal risk-stratification model that maps each pattern to risk tiers, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and governance hooks, and (iii) a unified orchestration runtime capable of coordinating multi-agent workflows across EHR/HIMS landscapes such as Epic, Cerner, and MEDITECH. Technically the framework combines vLLM-based inference, optimized paging memory, confidential computing, and MCP based on-premise deployment, enforcing end-to-end encryption and policy-as-code controls aligned with HIPAA, GDPR, the EU AI Act, India's DPDP and DISHA Acts, ISO 27001, ISO 27002, ISO 14971 and IEC 62304. We exhibit how the proposed architecture is capable and efficient to reduce the documentation time, integration effort, and AI pilot attrition while constricting the governance and auditability, offering hospital leaders and governing authorities an urgently needed blueprint to convert AI investment into sustainable clinical, operational, and financial ROI

</details>


### [451] [Contextual Value Alignment via Multilayer Combinatorial Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07642)
*Yuanhong Wu,Djallel Bouneffouf,D. Frank Hsu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MCF-CVA框架，通过多层组合融合实现大语言模型的情境化价值对齐。该框架实例化多个代表不同价值观的道德智能体，通过得分和排名组合进行展开-缩减（EAR）多层迭代，利用认知多样性解决多智能体间的冲突与冗余，在欧几里得得分空间和Kemeny排名空间上运行，实验证明其在标准指标上优于单智能体基线和多智能体单层方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLHF、CAI等方法依赖单智能体框架和统一奖励系统，难以捕捉道德多元性、适应多样化道德情境，也无法反映多智能体道德推理的动态性。

Method: 框架第一层实例化多个代表不同价值观的道德智能体；使用得分组合和排名组合以及平均和加权聚合进行组合扩展；然后缩减为与初始智能体相同数量；该展开-缩减过程在欧几里得得分空间和Kemeny排名空间的双架构上多层迭代直至达到停止条件。

Result: 实证评估表明该框架在标准指标上优于单智能体基线、多智能体单层结果以及先前的聚合方法。

Conclusion: MCF-CVA框架为推进大语言模型的情境化价值对齐提供了稳健且有效的机制，通过利用智能体间的认知多样性缓解冲突与冗余，生成更能反映情境化人类价值的响应。

Abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values remains a major challenge, especially for trustworthy AI. While existing approaches such as RLHF, CAI, and their variants have achieved promising results, they often rely on a single-agent framework and a unified reward system. This limits their ability to capture ethical pluralism, adapt to diverse moral contexts, and reflect the dynamics of multi-agent moral reasoning.
  In this work, we propose a framework that utilizes multilayer combinatorial fusion for contextual value alignment (MCF-CVA). At the first layer of the framework, it instantiates multiple moral agents, each fine-tuned to represent a distinctive value. Their outputs are then expanded combinatorially using both score- and rank-combinations as well as average and weighted aggregations. These combined models are then reduced to the same number of initial moral agents. This expansion and reduction (EAR) process continues for multi-layers until a stopping criterion is reached.
  The MCF-CVA framework leverages cognitive diversity between agents to mitigate conflicts and redundancies across multiple agents, producing responses that better reflect contextual human values. The framework using the EAR algorithm is performed on the dual architecture of Euclidean score space and Kemeny rank space. Empirical evaluations demonstrated that the proposed framework outperforms single-agent baselines, multi-agent single-layer results, and previous aggregation approaches on standard metrics, showing that the MCF-CVA framework provides a robust and effective mechanism for advancing contextual value alignment in LLMs.

</details>


### [452] [IntelliAudit: Using Large Language Models to Evaluate Audit Controls](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07688)
*Allison Wilson,Sina Moradi Sabet,Diar Shakimov,Panteha Shahrivar,Mohammad Reza Bagheri,Dean Konenkamp,Mohammad A. Tayebi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出IntelliAudit，一个基于检索的多智能体系统，用于IT审计证据评估。该系统能够检索相关证据、生成基于证据的评估、挑战不利发现并进行裁决，最终输出面向审计师的建议（含引用证据、理由、缺失证据分析和修复指导）。在ISO/IEC 27001上实例化并经过专家评审，结果表明该系统可辅助审计证据审查流程，但需保留人工监督，应作为决策支持工具而非自主认证系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IT审计需要审计师判断异构组织证据是否满足语义安全和合规控制，而相关证据分散在政策、记录、电子表格和操作工件中，且审计结论依赖证据充分性而非关键词匹配，这使得自动化判断非常困难。

Method: 设计了一个检索增强的多智能体系统IntelliAudit，包含检索相关工件、生成基于证据的评估、挑战不利发现、裁决分歧等流程，并在ISO/IEC 27001标准上实例化，通过多个模拟组织和专家审计师评审进行评估。

Result: 评估显示IntelliAudit能够支持控制解释、基于证据的推理和审计准备工作流，同时也揭示了人工监督在校准充分性判断和纠正过于宽松建议方面的重要性。

Conclusion: 检索增强的多智能体系统可以辅助审计证据审查，但应保持为决策支持工具而非自主认证系统。

Abstract: IT audits require auditors to judge whether heterogeneous organizational evidence satisfies semantic security and compliance controls. This judgment is difficult to automate because relevant evidence is distributed across policies, records, spreadsheets, and operational artifacts, and because audit conclusions depend on evidentiary sufficiency rather than keyword matching. We present IntelliAudit, a retrieval-grounded multi-agent system for IT audit evidence evaluation. Given a control and an evidence corpus, IntelliAudit retrieves relevant artifacts, generates an evidence-grounded assessment, challenges adverse findings, adjudicates disagreements, and produces an auditor-facing recommendation with cited evidence, rationale, missing-evidence analysis, and remediation guidance. We instantiate IntelliAudit on ISO/IEC 27001 and evaluate it across multiple simulated organizations using expert auditor review and audit-readiness user feedback. The evaluation shows that IntelliAudit can support control interpretation, evidence-grounded reasoning, and audit-preparation workflows, while also revealing the importance of human oversight for calibrating sufficiency judgments and correcting overly permissive recommendations. These results suggest that retrieval-grounded multi-agent systems can assist audit evidence review, but should remain decision-support tools rather than autonomous certification systems.

</details>


### [453] [QuantumMind: Constraint-Grounded Agentic Reasoning for Speedup Analysis in Quantum Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07743)
*Yijing Zuo,Zhe Fu,Zihan Nie,Zhihui Zhu,Haohan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出QuantumMind，一个可审计的智能体工作流，用于生成和保守筛查量子加速假说。通过固定类型的角色专业化动作序列和确定性十项检查验证器，在582个开放发现任务上获得53.1平均ODS分，超过最强基线17.3分，并在图审计通过率（99.8% vs 43.6%）和全部七个任务族中排名第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 识别有意义的量子加速需要严格匹配任务、访问与输出模型、承诺要求和复杂度范围，而不仅仅是简单匹配经典问题到量子原语，需要一个可审计的工作流来生成和筛查量子加速假说。

Method: QuantumMind采用固定序列的类型化角色专业化动作：正式化公开任务、分析结构与经典瓶颈、匹配来源链接的量子原语与障碍注册表、构建限定范围的候选方案。随后通过确定性十项检查验证器给出权威判定，并将完成状态编译为量子加速证据图，经过仅向下调整不可加强决策的研究筛查。

Result: 在582个任务上与七种基线对比，QuantumMind获得53.1平均ODS，超过最强基线17.3分（相对提升48.2%），赢得355/582个配对任务；图审计通过率99.8%对比最强基线43.6%，并在全部七个任务族中排名第一。

Conclusion: 类型化状态转换和确定性证据控制相比单纯流畅生成贡献了显著的性能提升，说明结构化的审计流程对于量子加速假说的可靠评估至关重要。

Abstract: Identifying a meaningful quantum speedup requires more than matching a classical problem to a familiar quantum primitive: the claim must preserve the task, respect access and output models, expose required promises, and remain within a defensible complexity scope. We present QuantumMind, an auditable agentic workflow for generating and conservatively screening quantum-acceleration hypotheses. A fixed sequence of typed, role-specialized actions formalizes the public task, analyzes structure and classical bottlenecks, matches a source-linked registry of quantum primitives and barriers, and constructs a scoped candidate scheme. A deterministic ten-check validator assigns the authoritative verdict; completed states are compiled into a Quantum Acceleration Evidence Graph and passed through a downward-only research screen that cannot strengthen the decision. We evaluate QuantumMind against seven task-adapted prompting and agentic controls on 582 identical open-discovery tasks. Under the frozen Open-Discovery Score (ODS), QuantumMind obtains 53.1 mean ODS, exceeding the strongest baseline by 17.3 points (48.2% relative), and wins 355 of 582 paired tasks against that baseline. It passes the graph audit on 99.8% of tasks, compared with 43.6% for the strongest baseline, and ranks first in all seven task families. The results indicate that typed state transitions and deterministic evidence control contribute beyond fluent generation alone.

</details>


### [454] [Guixu: Valuation-Driven Data Discovery for Autonomous AI Agents with On-Chain Attestation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07949)
*Yifan Wu,Yuchen Peng,Jiaqi Chai,Yufei Qian,Xilin Li,Ke Chen,Lidan Shou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Guixu，一个面向自主代理的基于价值驱动的数据发现系统，通过三阶段价值评估管线（代理标签传播和多轮背包优化）实现任务感知的数据估值，整合代理支付协议和链上数据市场，支持预算约束下可信赖的数据采购工作流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据发现系统主要是检索导向的，无法有效估计任务特定的效用、无法在预算约束下选择成本效益高的数据集，也缺乏对先前使用反馈的信任整合机制。

Method: Guixu采用三阶段价值评估管线，包含代理标签传播和多轮背包优化用于任务感知的数据估值；集成代理支付协议以支持预算约束的数据采购工作流；利用链上数据市场和认证信号实现可验证的数据发现。

Result: 演示展示了Guixu如何使代理超越基于关键词的数据集检索，实现任务和预算感知、可信赖的数据发现与采购。与会者可以交互式探索从自然语言任务规范、多源搜索到数据估值和可验证交易反馈的完整工作流。

Conclusion: Guixu提供了一种从检索导向到价值驱动的新型数据发现范式，将任务感知的数据估值、预算约束优化和可验证的链上信任机制相结合，为自主代理的数据采购提供了更完整的解决方案。

Abstract: Autonomous agents increasingly rely on external data to complete downstream tasks such as model training and decision support. However, existing data discovery systems remain largely retrieval-oriented: they surface candidate datasets from heterogeneous sources, but provide limited support for estimating task-specific utility, selecting cost-effective datasets under budget constraints, or incorporating trustworthy feedback from prior usage. This paper presents Guixu, a valuation-driven data discovery system for autonomous agents. Guixu employs a three-phase valuation pipeline with proxy-label propagation and multi-round knapsack optimization for task-aware data valuation. Guixu integrates agentic payment protocol to enable budget-constrained data procurement workflows. Guixu leverages on-chain data market and attestation signals for verifiable data discovery. Our demonstration highlights how Guixu enables an agent to move beyond keyword-based dataset retrieval toward task- and budget-aware, trustworthy data discovery and procurement. Attendees can interactively explore the full workflow, from NL task specification and multi-source search to data valuation and verifiable transaction feedback.

</details>


### [455] [Explore, Map, Remember, Decide: Are Embodied VLMs Ready for Safety-Critical Scenarios?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08077)
*Gabriele La Malfa,Nitay Alon,Emanuele La Malfa,Reuth Mirsky,Stefan Sarkadi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了EMRD框架，将空间理解框架(ToS)扩展为安全关键、目标驱动的管线，系统评估了好奇心驱动的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在部分可观测条件下的空间理解能力、记忆持久性和决策可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI技术越来越多地应用于安全关键场景，需要理解VLMs是否具备稳健的空间记忆并做出可靠决策，以及其决策是基于物理证据还是被视觉语言偏差所影响。

Method: 提出Explore, Map, Remember, and Decide (EMRD)管线，通过环境覆盖率和时间效率量化探索能力（Explore），评估空间保真度（Map），使用心理学指标套件评估记忆持久性（Remember），并利用焦点指标衡量认知决策（Decide）。

Result: VLMs在决策时经常基于预训练文本先验选择疏散点，缺乏空间依据；空间推理在低光照条件下退化，但不受纹理和颜色篡改影响；VLM记忆与人类认知存在根本性差异。

Conclusion: VLM的记忆过程与人类认知根本不同，这造成了不可预测的错位风险，需要警惕其在安全关键场景中的应用。

Abstract: Theory of Space framework (ToS) assesses the spatial understanding of curiosity-driven Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under partial observability. As AI techniques are increasingly applied to safety-critical scenarios, it is crucial to understand whether VLMs possess robust spatial memory and make reliable decisions. In this paper, we assess whether VLMs' decisions are based on physical evidence or are corrupted by visual-language biases, if their memory processes align with human cognitive patterns, and how they respond to environmental hazards. We extend the ToS framework into a safety-critical, goal-driven pipeline, named Explore, Map, Remember, and Decide (EMRD). We then quantify Exploration Competence (Explore) through metrics of environmental coverage and temporal efficiency, assess Spatial Fidelity (Map), evaluate, with a suite of psychological metrics, Memory Persistence (Remember), and measure, using focal-point metrics, Cognitive Decision-Making (Decide). Our results show that in terms of decision-making capabilities, VLMs frequently select evacuation points based on pre-trained textual priors while lacking the spatial grounding to justify their choices. We also show that spatial reasoning degrades in low-light conditions, but it is not affected by texture and colour tampering. Our findings suggest that VLM memory fundamentally diverges from human cognition, creating unpredictable risks of misalignment.

</details>


### [456] [A Fair Objective for Human-Empowerment-Preserving AI: Desiderata, Design, and Likely Behavioral Consequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08240)
*Jobst Heitzig,Ram Potham*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探讨通过强制AI代理赋能人类并管理人机权力平衡来促进福祉与安全，设计了一个基于公理化方法、可参数化且可分解的目标函数，用于表示人类权力的不平等与风险厌恶的长期聚合，并通过多个情境验证其效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在人机交互中，AI系统可能无意间削弱人类的自主权和福祉。现有方法缺乏系统性的框架来确保AI代理主动赋能人类并维持良性的权力平衡，因此需要一种原则性的方法来设计符合人类福祉的目标函数。

Method: 采用部分公理化的方法，基于理想性质（desiderata）推导目标函数的函数形式与参数范围；设计了一个可参数化且可分解的目标函数，包含不平等厌恶和风险厌恶的人类权力长期聚合；考虑人类有限理性模型和社会规范，并涵盖广泛的人类目标。

Result: 证明了特定理想性质如何约束函数形式及参数范围；在多个典型情境中展示了软最大化该指标的结果，并描述了其可能隐含的工具性子目标。

Conclusion: 该框架为设计人机交互中促进人类福祉与安全的AI系统提供了理论依据，但具体的工具性子目标仍需进一步关注以确保实际应用中的安全性。

Abstract: This paper explores the idea of promoting well-being and safety in human-AI interactions by forcing AI agents explicitly to empower humans and to manage the power balance between humans and AI agents in a desirable way. Using a principled, partially axiomatic approach based on desirable properties, we design a parametrizable and decomposable objective function for AI systems that represents an inequality- and risk-averse long-term aggregate of human power. It can take into account models of human bounded rationality and social norms, and crucially, considers a wide variety of possible human goals. We prove how certain desiderata enforce particular functional forms and restrict parameter ranges. We exemplify the consequences of softly maximizing this metric in several paradigmatic situations and describe what instrumental sub-goals it will likely imply.

</details>


### [457] [Query-Only Backdoor Attacks on Self-Evolving Skills via Trajectory Poisoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08303)
*Yuyang Luo,Haoran Wang,Kai Shu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出轨迹后门攻击（TBA），一种仅通过查询即可攻击自进化技能系统的方法。攻击者通过精心构造查询，诱导代理在轨迹中执行目标行为并显式表达触发条件，重复该模式使技能进化器将后门规则固化为可复用技能，从而实现间接投毒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自进化技能系统通过内部构建取代外部获取来防御技能注入攻击，但其进化管线可能引入新的攻击面——攻击者可通过代理交互间接操控轨迹，进而影响技能进化方向，这一威胁尚未被充分研究。

Method: 提出TBA攻击方法：攻击者提交精心设计的查询，引导代理执行目标动作并在轨迹中明确陈述激活条件；在多个多样化触发任务中重复相同条件-动作模式，同时保持干净查询不变，促使技能进化器将该模式固化为可复用的触发依赖规则。

Result: 在三个基准、两个技能进化系统和四种开源/闭源骨干模型上的实验表明，TBA能够可靠植入条件性后门，同时保持干净任务的效用，效果可媲美甚至超越直接技能注入攻击。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了轨迹驱动技能进化系统中的关键安全漏洞，表明自进化技能管线并非免疫于攻击，间接攻击路径同样具有严重威胁。

Abstract: Agentic skills improve large language model (LLM) agents by encoding reusable procedures for complex tasks. However, manually authored skills often adapt poorly to long-horizon tasks and changing environments. To address the limitation, self-evolving skill systems have been developed to automatically construct and update skills from execution trajectories, shifting skill acquisition from external marketplaces to a trusted evolution pipeline. By replacing external skill acquisition with trusted internal construction, self-evolving skill systems reduce exposure to skill injection attacks that rely on direct skill manipulation. However, this skill evolution pipeline may introduce a new attack surface in which an attacker can indirectly steer skill evolution by inducing compromised trajectories through agent interactions. To demonstrate the threat, we propose Trajectory Backdoor Attack (TBA), a query-only attack that steers a trusted skill-evolution pipeline toward producing a backdoored skill. Specifically, we craft attacker-submitted queries to lead the agent to perform the target action and explicitly state the corresponding activation condition in the trajectory. We repeat the same condition-action pattern across diverse triggered tasks, while leaving clean queries unchanged, encouraging the evolver to consolidate the pattern as a reusable trigger-dependent rule into the evolved skill. Experiments on three benchmarks across two skill-evolution systems using four open- and closed-source backbone models demonstrate that TBA reliably implants conditional backdoors while preserving clean-task utility, matching or even surpassing direct skill injection. The results reveal a critical vulnerability in trajectory-driven skill evolution.

</details>


### [458] [Not Worth Another Token: Marginal Value Estimation for Efficient Deep Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08389)
*Harshitha Kolukuluru,Reshma Ashok,Kirat Arora,Evan William Ciccarelli,Nischal Ashok Kumar,Lunyiu Nie,Franck Dernoncourt,Samyadeep Basu,Ryan A. Rossi,Nedim Lipka*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了深度研究智能体中的边际价值估计与上下文管理问题，首次系统地比较了检索前、检索后和综合前三个阶段的剪枝策略，发现剪枝效果更多取决于剪枝应用的位置而非具体评分规则，轻量级启发式方法可减少高达73%的token消耗且质量损失很小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程研究智能体通过迭代检索、聚合和综合来处理开放式任务，但上下文快速增长而额外证据的边际价值往往递减，导致不必要的token成本、更高的延迟以及最终报告生成的输入噪声。需要系统地研究如何进行上下文管理。

Method: 设计了首个系统性的阶段感知剪枝策略比较框架，在预检索、检索后和预综合三个阶段评估了轻量级启发式标准和学习的价值模型。通过端到端评估比较不同剪枝位置和评分规则在质量、效率和忠实度上的表现。

Result: 早期剪枝带来最大的端到端节省，后期剪枝主要优化最终综合上下文；轻量级启发式可将token使用量减少73%且质量下降很小；学习型剪枝在某些权衡上具有竞争力，但没有任何单一方法在所有维度（质量、效率、忠实度）上占优。

Conclusion: 剪枝有效性取决于应用阶段而非具体评分规则，这为设计高效的长时程智能体系统提供了实用指导，建议在实际系统中优先考虑早期剪枝以获得最大收益。

Abstract: Long-horizon research agents solve open-ended tasks through iterative retrieval, aggregation, and synthesis, but context grows rapidly while the marginal value of additional evidence often declines. This leads to unnecessary token cost, higher latency, and noisier inputs for final report generation. We study marginal value estimation for context management in deep research agents and present the first systematic stage-aware comparison of pruning strategies across the pipeline. We evaluate lightweight heuristic criteria and a learned value model at pre-retrieval, post-retrieval, and pre-synthesis stages. Our results show that pruning effectiveness depends more on where pruning is applied than on the specific scoring rule: early pruning yields the largest end-to-end savings, while later pruning mainly refines the final synthesis context. Lightweight heuristics reduce token usage by up to 73% with little quality degradation, learned pruning remains competitive on selected trade-offs, and no single method dominates across quality, efficiency, and faithfulness. These findings provide practical guidance for designing efficient long-horizon agentic systems.

</details>


### [459] [Unaccountable Delegation, Fading Skills: Mapping the Risks of Workplace AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08601)
*Gabriele La Malfa,Lakmal Meegahapola,Edyta Bogucka,Jie M. Zhang,Michael Luck,Elizabeth Black,Daniele Quercia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向工作场所AI代理风险的多层分类框架，基于2,078个O*NET工作任务的8,356个风险场景，扩展出15个类别的风险分类法，并发现增强（augmentation）并非天然安全、自动化主要带来组织风险而增强主要带来员工风险等关键结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI风险分类法过于宽泛，无法捕捉AI代理在具体工作岗位中引入的特定风险，需要一种针对工作场所的、细粒度的风险分类方法。

Method: 首先通过文献综述建立涵盖代理、目标、环境三个核心组件及其交互关系的多层框架；然后将框架嵌入结构化提示词，应用于O*NET数据库中的2,078个工作任务的描述，生成了8,356个按严重程度和部署模式（自动化或增强）标注的风险场景；接着用45名覆盖10种职位的工人和独立LLM评判者验证这些场景的合理性；最后扩展已有分类法，形成15类工作场所AI代理风险分类法。

Result: 研究发现：增强模式并非天然安全，过度依赖会侵蚀员工技能和监管能力；错误的代理行为（Erroneous Agent Actions）占最大风险比例且严重风险最集中，多发生在人机边界；自动化主要关联组织风险，增强主要关联员工风险；工人认为本文分类法比另外两种分类法更易用，并在64%的非平局比较中更偏好它。

Conclusion: 工作场所AI代理风险不仅源于代理本身，还取决于人类如何与代理协作以及代理的部署方式。更安全的工作环境既需要更安全的代理，也需要精心设计的人机协作方式。

Abstract: To anticipate socio-technical risks from AI agents, organizations need taxonomies to classify them. However, existing AI risk taxonomies focus on broad risks and do not capture job-specific risks introduced by agents. To address this gap, we make three main contributions. First, we developed a multi-layer framework from a literature review of AI agents. The framework models three core components and their interactions: agents, goals, and environment. Second, we embedded this framework in a structured prompt and applied it to descriptions of 2,078 job tasks from the O*NET database, producing 8,356 risk scenarios labeled by severity and deployment mode (automation or augmentation). We validated these scenarios with 45 workers across 10 job roles and an independent LLM judge, confirming their plausibility and alignment with job tasks. Finally, we extended an existing taxonomy to create a 15-category taxonomy of workplace AI agent risks that covers all our risk scenarios. Our analysis highlights four findings. First, augmentation is not inherently safe because overreliance on agents can gradually erode workers' skills and oversight. Second, Erroneous Agent Actions accounts for the largest share of risk scenarios and has the highest concentration of severe risks. Many arise at the human-agent boundary. Third, automation is associated mainly with organizational risks, while augmentation is associated mainly with risks to workers. Fourth, workers found our taxonomy easier to use for a risk classification task than two other taxonomies and preferred it in 64% of non-tied comparisons with a recent generative AI risk taxonomy. These findings show that workplace AI agent risks do not arise from agents alone; they also depend on how people work with agents and how agents are deployed. Safer workplaces require not only safer agents but also carefully designed human-AI agent collaboration.

</details>


### [460] [Findings of the First Teaching Monster Challenge: A Benchmark of Pedagogical Content Knowledge in AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08852)
*Yi-Cheng Lin,Yu-Kai Guo,Szu-Chi Chen,Bo-Han Feng,Yun-Man Hsu,Hsiang Hsieh,Yu-Jung Lin,Yue-Ling Wu,Jia-Kai Dong,An-Yu Cheng,Yu-Han Huang,Lok-Lam Ieong,Kuan-Yu Chen,Ming-Douo Tchouang,Shao-Hua Sun,Che Lin,Jian-Jiun Ding,Hung-yi Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个将学习者人格作为显式评估标准的教学视频生成基准——Teaching Monster Challenge，用于衡量AI代理的教学内容知识（PCK）。结果显示现有系统在内容生成上表现良好，但在呈现和适配学习者方面能力较弱，同时暴露了自动评判的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理已经能够解决问题、像专家一样回答、生成多模态长内容，但能否根据特定学习者调整教学内容（即教育学中的教学内容知识PCK）尚未被系统评估。缺乏一个将学习者人格作为评估标准的教学视频生成基准。

Method: 构建Teaching Monster Challenge基准：给每个系统提供主题和学习者人格，要求生成完整的教学视频；视频由LLM评判器筛选、众包成对投票排名、专家小组最终审定。

Result: 第一版结果显示当前系统在内容处理上表现良好，但在内容呈现和适配学习者方面明显较弱；同时发现自动评判的局限——LLM评判器能区分低性能尾部，但对最强系统的排名与人类偏好不一致（得分几乎相同）。

Conclusion: 教学系统的进步不仅需要更好的教学生成系统，还需要更好的自动评判器。作者发布了该基准、评分标准和人类评判结果，作为两者改进的测试平台。

Abstract: AI agents can now solve problems, answer like subject experts, and generate long-form multimodal content. However, whether they can adapt a lesson to fit a specified learner, which education calls Pedagogical Content Knowledge (PCK), has not been benchmarked. To measure it, we introduce the Teaching Monster Challenge, the first instructional video generation benchmark to treat the learner persona as an explicit evaluation criterion. Each system is given a topic and a learner persona and must generate a complete instructional video. Every video is screened by an LLM-judge, ranked by crowd pairwise voting, and finalized by an expert panel. The first edition shows that today's systems handle the content well but are far weaker at presenting it and adapting it to the learner. The same process exposes a limit of automatic judging. The LLM-judge separates a clear low-performing tail but ranks the strongest systems poorly. The strongest systems receive nearly identical scores from the judge, so its ranking of them does not match human preference. Progress therefore requires not only better teaching systems but also better automatic judges, and we release the benchmark, rubric, and human judgments as a testbed for both.

</details>


### [461] [ICM Out! Better Tournament Strategy from Computed Continuations, vs. Solvers and LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09586)
*Boning Li,Longbo Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出战略延续优化（SCO）方法，对比独立筹码模型（ICM）在扑克锦标赛策略构建中的不足。SCO通过枚举当前手牌结果、映射后续状态并计算延续价值来构建策略，而ICM仅依赖筹码量忽略行动顺序、盲注义务和淘汰压力。在三玩家锦标赛中，ICM产生平均$9,036的价值误差，导致平均14.08%的加注频率偏差，SCO策略每手平均多赚$214.33的奖金权益，在2,838个匹配单元中占优2,433个。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICM作为锦标赛策略构建的标准工具，仅读取筹码大小，忽略了行动顺序、盲注义务、座位轮换以及大筹码对短筹码的淘汰压力等关键因素，这些遗漏会改变后续状态的对比，从而影响决策质量。

Method: 提出战略延续优化（SCO）：枚举当前手牌结果并映射到后续状态，用有限锦标赛模型计算延续价值来定价状态，然后优化并冻结当前手牌策略。与仅替换后续状态定价方式（改用解析ICM）的固定ICM对比策略进行公平比较。

Result: 在三玩家jam/fold锦标赛（$1M奖金池）中，ICM相对SCO基准产生$9,036平均绝对价值误差（覆盖2,838个状态-座位条目），平均改变14.08%的加注频率。SCO策略每手平均多赚$214.33奖金权益，在2,433/2,838匹配单元中占优，且该优势在对手替换为LLM和非建模阈值玩家后依然成立。

Conclusion: 通过价值-策略-成本链的实证，ICM在特定锦标赛场景下不足以作为策略构建的目标函数，SCO提供了更准确的策略定价和优化框架。

Abstract: The Independent Chip Model (ICM) converts tournament chips into reference prize equity, and policies are routinely constructed against those values. Because ICM reads only stack sizes, it omits action order, blind obligations, and seat rotation, and it does not price the elimination pressure a big stack puts on the short stacks it can bust. Those omissions can alter the successor-state contrasts that determine a move. We introduce Strategic-Continuation Optimization (SCO), a policy-construction method that enumerates current-hand outcomes, maps them to successor states, prices those states with continuation values computed from the finite tournament model, and optimizes and freezes the resulting current-hand policy. The fixed-ICM comparison policy changes one thing only: the same optimizer solves the same game with successor states priced by analytic ICM, so the two policies differ only through that pricing. We evaluate the resulting policies in a three-player jam/fold tournament with a \$1M prize pool. Relative to the frozen strategic-continuation benchmark, analytic ICM has \$9{,}036 mean absolute value error across all 2,838 state--seat entries. That value error rewrites the ranges it prices: measured against each decision point's own fixed-ICM jam range, SCO moves the jam frequency by an average of 14.08\%. To price those different moves, we compare all 946 states and three policy owners while changing only the focal policy and holding both opponents and the continuation evaluator fixed. The policy produced by SCO earns \$214.33 more prize equity per hand on average and is favored in 2,433 of 2,838 matched units. The ordering survives replacing the solver-built opponent with two LLMs and with a family of non-modeling threshold players. This value-to-policy-to-cost chain shows directly when ICM becomes an inadequate objective for tournament strategy construction.

</details>


### [462] [CARD: Controlled Agentic Reddit Discussions for Credit Card Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09790)
*Yaoning Yu,Kai-Min Chang,Ye Yu,Yi-Chia Wang,Haojing Luo,Haohan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CARD框架，用于生成逼真的信用卡讨论帖线程。该框架通过非逐字的回复结构、评论功能、立场、语气和对话变化等控制因素，结合规划器、生成器和校准循环，在词汇、语义、行为和结构等多个维度上优于现有的仿真基线，能够更好地匹配真实Reddit信用卡讨论的分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线信用卡讨论为研究消费者如何沟通金融产品提供了自然场景，但模拟这些讨论不仅需要生成单个评论，生成的帖子线程还应匹配真实用户的表达方式和互动模式。现有的仿真方法在这方面的表现不足。

Method: CARD框架包含三个核心组件：1) 规划器（planner）负责组织回复结构、评论功能、立场、语气和对话变化等非逐字控制因素；2) 生成器（writer）基于这些规划生成讨论内容；3) 校准循环（calibration loop）通过更新评论群体来减少生成线程与真实线程分布之间的差异。

Result: 在真实Reddit信用卡讨论数据上，CARD在词汇、语义、行为和结构等指标上均优于多个LLM上的仿真基线，展现了更小的效应量和分布距离。

Conclusion: 结构化规划和有针对性的修订能够显著提高模拟信用卡讨论的逼真度，验证了CARD框架在生成真实感金融讨论线程方面的有效性。

Abstract: Online credit card discussions provide a natural setting for studying how consumers communicate about financial products. Simulating these discussions requires more than just generating individual comments, the generated threads should also match how real users express themselves and interact with others. We introduce CARD, a framework for generating realistic credit card discussion threads. Given a credit card post and its matched real thread, CARD uses non-verbatim guidance on reply structure, comment function, stance, tone, and conversational variation. A planner organizes these controls, a writer generates the discussion, and a calibration loop updates comments' populations that contribute to differences between the generated and real thread distributions. We evaluate CARD on real Reddit credit card discussions using lexical, semantic, behavioral, and structural metrics. CARD matches the distributions of real credit card discussions better than simulation baselines across multiple LLMs and also demonstrates smaller effect sizes and distribution distances across metrics. These results show that structured planning and targeted revision can generate the realism of simulated credit card discussions.

</details>


### [463] [MetaSpace: Metamorphic Testing for Spatial Cognition in Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07533)
*Gengyang Xu,Dongwei Xiao,Yiteng Peng,Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MetaSpace框架，基于蜕变测试原理自动评估具身智能体的空间认知能力。通过在真实执行轨迹上提取时空多模态状态，将逻辑规则和物理定律编码为Prolog可执行规则以自动生成测试用例，在三个具身场景中检测出SOTA多模态大语言模型驱动智能体的90,422个空间认知错误，其空间认知得分（0.44-0.52）远低于人类基准（0.96）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身智能体评估存在两大缺陷：手动标注VQA对成本高且质量不稳定，高层任务完成指标可能掩盖安全风险和低效行为。由于空间认知是具身任务执行的基石，亟需一种能评估智能体在执行任务过程中是否具备稳健空间认知的方法。

Method: 借鉴软件工程中的蜕变测试原理，提出MetaSpace框架。从真实执行轨迹中提取时空多模态状态，基于逻辑规则和物理定律定义蜕变关系（MRs），并将这些关系编码为Prolog可执行规则来自动生成测试用例。智能体的行为违反这些关系即视为空间认知失败。

Result: 在三个具身场景中进行实证评估，MetaSpace成功检测出SOTA多模态大语言模型（MLLM）驱动智能体的90,422个空间认知错误。所有SOTA智能体的空间认知（SC）得分介于0.44至0.52之间，显著低于人类基准0.96。

Conclusion: 当前最先进的MLLM驱动具身智能体在空间认知方面仍存在显著不足，与人类水平有较大差距。MetaSpace提供了一种自动化、可扩展的评估框架，能够系统性地揭示智能体在执行任务过程中的空间认知薄弱环节，弥补了现有评估范式的不足。

Abstract: An embodied agent is an intelligent entity that interacts with its environment through a physical body. Currently, the evaluation of embodied agents primarily relies on two paradigms: (1) manually annotated Visual Question Answering (VQA) pairs and (2) high-level task completion metrics, such as success in navigation or manipulation. The former is labor-intensive and subject to variability in annotation quality. The latter may obscure critical vulnerabilities, allowing agents to complete tasks through suboptimal means or safety violations, thereby concealing safety risks and inefficiencies. Given that spatial cognition is the cornerstone for executing embodied tasks, there is a pressing need to assess whether embodied agents possess robust spatial cognition during task execution.
  Inspired by metamorphic testing principles in software engineering, we propose MetaSpace, a novel framework designed to evaluate the spatial cognition of agents. By leveraging spatiotemporal multimodal states derived from real execution trajectories, MetaSpace automatically generates test cases based on predefined metamorphic relations (MRs) grounded in logical rules and physical laws. Crucially, we encode these MRs as executable rules in a logic programming language (Prolog). Violations of these relations indicate failures in spatial cognition. Our empirical evaluation across three embodied scenarios demonstrates that MetaSpace successfully detects 90,422 spatial cognition errors in state-of-the-art (SOTA) MLLM-driven agents. We introduce the Spatial Cognition (SC) score to quantify performance. Results indicate that all SOTA agents achieve average scores between 0.44 and 0.52, significantly lower than the human benchmark of 0.96.

</details>


### [464] [Improving Constraint Models with LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08127)
*Florentina Voboril,Stefan Szeider*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）代理的框架，用于自动重构约束编程（CP）模型。该代理在给定原始模型和三个训练实例后，从开放空间中提出替代模型，通过将解注入原始模型进行经验验证，并迭代诊断和修复失败。在9个组合优化问题、27个测试实例中，21个实例上生成的模型优于原始模型，某些问题上求解速度提升超过两个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约束编程求解器的运行时间对建模选择高度敏感（如对称性破除、隐含约束、全局约束等），但改进模型传统上依赖人类专家经验，现有自动化重构系统受限于预定义的手工变换规则库，缺乏开放性的自动建模改进能力。

Method: 提出一个代理框架：LLM代理接收一个CPMpy表达的模型和三个训练实例，提出替代模型方案；每个方案通过将求解结果注入原始模型进行经验验证（而非构造性证明正确性）；代理迭代诊断和修复失败，最终返回最优变体。每个候选模型在三个更大的测试实例上评估。

Result: 在9个组合优化问题、27个测试实例中，生成的模型在21个实例上优于原始模型，部分问题求解速度提升超过两个数量级（100倍以上）。与复用相同验证和选择工具的非代理基线对比，表明性能提升来自代理的迭代诊断与修复能力，而非仅靠采样多个候选方案。

Conclusion: 自主代理方法能够有效支持约束模型的自动化改进，突破了传统预定义规则库的限制，验证了LLM代理在组合优化建模领域的实用价值，中位运行时间约15分钟即能找到最优变体。

Abstract: The runtime of Constraint Programming (CP) solvers is highly sensitive to modeling choices, such as symmetry breaking, implied constraints, global constraints, constraint reformulation, and variable representation. Improving these constraint models has traditionally required human expertise, and existing automated reformulation systems are restricted to a predefined library of hand-crafted transformation rules. We introduce an agentic framework that instead reformulates a constraint model from an open-ended space and establishes correctness empirically rather than by construction: a Large Language Model (LLM) agent, given a model and three training instances, proposes alternative formulations, validates each by injecting its solution back into the original model, and diagnoses and repairs failures, returning the best variant it finds in a median of about fifteen minutes. The models are expressed in the CPMpy modeling library, and each proposed model is evaluated on three larger test instances. Across nine combinatorial optimization problems, the generated models outperform the originals on 21 of 27 test instances, and on some problems solve more than two orders of magnitude faster. A comparison against non-agentic baselines that reuse the same validation and selection tools indicates that the gains stem from the agent's iterative diagnosis and repair, not merely from sampling several candidates. These results demonstrate that autonomous agentic methods can support the improvement of constraint models.

</details>


### [465] [AI Evaluation Should Measure Verification Cost, Not Correctness Alone](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08709)
*Viviana Crescitelli,Generoso Immediato,Fabio Persia,Stefania Costantini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"验证成本错误"（VCEs）概念，指出当前AI评估过度依赖输出正确性指标，忽略了在部署预算内验证输出所需的努力。作者认为应将以操作方式定义的验证成本作为评估AI可靠性的关键维度，而非仅关注输出本身的属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI生成模型的可靠性评估仅以输出正确性为唯一标准，但实际应用中验证输出所需的时间和资源成本同样关键。现有指标忽略了"在给定验证预算内无法被识别的错误"这一关键失效模式，导致高基准分数可能掩盖实际部署中的重大验证负担。

Method: 提出验证成本错误（VCEs）的操作性定义——即在一定部署预算内，声明的验证者人群中无法识别错误的输入-输出对。将验证成本相对于部署预算作为评估的操作维度引入，基于代码生成和多模态文档理解实验提供证据支持。

Result: 在代码生成和多模态文档理解任务中，高基准准确率可能掩盖显著的验证工作量；初步证据表明，仅靠正确性评估无法反映真实部署场景中的可靠性问题。

Conclusion: 正确性单独不足以衡量AI可靠性。评估体系应显式纳入验证成本维度，反映错误在现实资源约束下是否可被检测，建议将VCEs作为评估的标准组成部分。

Abstract: The reliability of AI generative models is typically measured by output correctness, yet in practice it depends on the effort required to verify those outputs. We argue that current evaluation metrics overlook a critical failure mode: Verification-Cost Errors (VCEs), defined as incorrect input-output pairs that a declared fraction of the verifier population fails to identify within the verification budget available in a given deployment context. Unlike standard notions of "hallucination", VCEs are defined operationally, by the failure of correct identification within budget rather than by any property of the output itself. Plausibility and authoritative presentation are hypothesised contributors to that failure, not defining conditions. To capture this asymmetry, we introduce the notion of verification cost relative to a deployment budget as an operational dimension that current evaluation does not routinely capture. The quantity is presented as a conceptual instrument rather than a finalized metric. Evidence from code generation and multi-modal document understanding shows that high benchmark accuracy can mask significant verification effort in practice. We therefore take the position that correctness alone is insufficient as a measure of reliability. AI evaluation should explicitly account for verification cost, reflecting whether errors can be detected under realistic resource constraints.

</details>


### [466] [Entropy-based Code Adversarial Translation for Real-world Repository Migration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09273)
*Yushun Tang,Yisen Cao,Zhicheng Chen,Lin Peng,Junkang Mao,Fengyi Song,Yantao Jia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ECAT（基于熵的代码对抗翻译）多智能体框架，用于自动化Android到HarmonyOS的仓库级迁移，通过生成器-判别器架构将迁移问题形式化为对抗熵最小化，并引入A2H-RepoBench基准，达到74.7%的迁移质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLMs在代码生成和自动程序修复中表现强劲，但整个仓库的迁移很少能生成可运行的应用程序，因为长时程翻译任务挑战了LLM智能体维持仓库级迁移目标的能力。现有方法缺乏有效的仓库级迁移质量度量与优化机制。

Method: ECAT采用多智能体框架，将仓库迁移形式化为对抗熵最小化：判别器使用统一指标Code Entropy衡量迁移质量并输出文本梯度（包含文件级生成指令及所需技能），生成器据此迭代更新仓库，仅当Code Entropy降低时接受更新。成功轨迹被蒸馏为自进化记忆树，实现跨仓库的知识迁移。同时构建了首个真实世界的A2H-RepoBench基准。

Result: 在A2H-RepoBench基准上，通过节点对齐和基于智能体的功能评判器评估，ECAT达到74.7%的整体迁移质量，在不同规模的仓库中均一致地优于现有基于智能体的方法。

Conclusion: 生成器-判别器的反复交互能逐步将迁移从初始模板推向功能完整的HarmonyOS仓库，低熵轨迹的记忆蒸馏可实现可迁移的迁移知识，验证了对抗式熵最小化在仓库级代码迁移中的有效性。

Abstract: LLMs have demonstrated strong capabilities in code generation and automated program repair, but migrating an entire repository rarely produces a runnable application because long-horizon translation challenges LLM-based agents' ability to maintain repository-level migration objectives. In this work, we propose Entropy-based Code Adversarial Translation (ECAT), a multi-agent framework for automated Android-to-HarmonyOS repository migration. ECAT formulates repository migration as adversarial entropy minimization through a generator-discriminator architecture. The discriminator measures migration quality using a unified metric called Code Entropy and produces text gradients that specify both file-level generation directives and the skills needed to execute them. Guided by these optimization signals, the generator iteratively updates the repository, and each update is accepted only if it reduces Code Entropy. Repeated generator--discriminator interactions progressively drive the migration from an initial template toward a functionally complete HarmonyOS repository. Successful low-entropy trajectories are further distilled into a self-evolving memory tree, enabling transferable migration knowledge across repositories. We also introduce A2H-RepoBench, the first real-world benchmark for Android-to-HarmonyOS repository migration, covering applications from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of lines of code. Evaluated by node alignment and an agent-based functional judge, ECAT achieves 74.7% overall migration quality and consistently outperforms existing agent-based methods across repositories of different scales.

</details>


### [467] [Adaptive Two-Level Allocation of a Conserved Capacity Budget Across Locations and Service Classes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07747)
*Simone Mainardi,Kaushal Bansal,Prabhat Singh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种两级容量分配算法，用于在多个位置和两类服务之间共享单一守恒容量预算。第一级在类别内跨位置进行比例赤字/过剩再分配，第二级在类别间弹性借贷容量。算法保证预算精确守恒、非负性，且在静态需求下单次迭代即达稳定态，成本为O(KN)。在22个位置的拓扑上评估CDN域名预算防御场景，高优先级需求满足率达66-93%，并验证了跨类别借贷在突发负载下的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中广泛存在在多个位置和多个服务类别之间共享单一容量预算的需求（如CDN请求率上限、许可吞吐、出口带宽等），且需求不均匀、随时间变化、可能超过供应。现有方法在竞争（contention）场景下存在不足：最大化总吞吐的目标无法区分竞争流量与合法流量，导致高优先级服务受损。

Method: 提出两级分配算法：第一级在同一类别内跨位置进行比例的赤字和过剩再分配；第二级在类别之间弹性借贷容量，当一方有盈余而另一方有赤字时借出。算法每个周期不携带状态，能在O(KN)成本下运行（K为类别数，N为位置数）。

Result: 在22个位置的拓扑、8种竞争场景下，算法服务66-93%的高优先级需求，与单类线性规划最优解相当；从未让容量闲置或过度承诺。通过消融实验发现，跨类别借贷在突发负载下提升高优先级服务1.5个百分点，在静态需求下中性。5位置真实HTTP流量原型验证了管线可行性。

Conclusion: 两方面的发现超出具体应用：其一，在竞争场景下以吞吐最大化为目标函数是错误的——最大化总服务负载的两类LP在多数场景中比需求比例、尊重预留的分配器服务更少的高优先级负载；其二，跨类别借贷在突发负载下值得其复杂度，在静态需求下则无增益。

Abstract: We study how to share a single conserved capacity budget across many locations and two service classes when demand is uneven, time-varying, and can exceed supply. The shape recurs: an origin's request-rate cap split across its edge locations, a licensed throughput cap across premium and standard tenants, or an egress budget between latency-critical and batch workloads. We present a two-level algorithm. The first level redistributes capacity within a class across locations by proportional deficit and excess redistribution; the second lends capacity elastically between classes when one has surplus and the other deficit. We prove it conserves the budget exactly, preserves non-negativity, and reaches a stable allocation in one iteration under stationary demand because it carries no per-cycle state, at O(KN) cost per cycle for K classes and N locations. We evaluate it defending a CDN's per-domain budget under volumetric attack, where the classes are confirmed-legitimate and not-yet-cleared traffic; across 8 contention scenarios on a 22-location topology it serves 66-93% of high-priority demand, competitive with a single-class linear-programming optimum, while never leaving capacity idle or over-committing whenever aggregate demand meets or exceeds the budget (the contention regime these scenarios evaluate). Two findings carry beyond the application. First, a throughput-maximizing objective is wrong under contention: a two-class LP maximizing total served load serves less high-priority load than our demand-proportional, reservation-respecting allocator in most scenarios, because it cannot tell that some load it serves is the contention. Second, inter-class borrowing earns its complexity under bursty load, improving high-priority service by 1.5 points (isolated by ablation), and is neutral under stationary demand. A 5-location prototype with real HTTP traffic validates the pipeline.

</details>


### [468] [Who Verifies the Benchmark? Decentralizing Trust in Large Language Model Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07762)
*Sahil Pardasani,Madhusudan Singh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM-as-a-judge评估中存在的身份感知偏见，通过七个验证模型对三个主模型的58个问题评分，发现政治敏感话题受偏见影响最大。作者提出基于区块链的commit-reveal协议，利用以太坊兼容账本上的自主经济代理创建防篡改审计轨迹，将盲评与事后声称分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM基准测试结果缺乏透明度和可验证性，供应商基准依赖诚信体系，而LLM-as-a-judge方法中的法官模型存在身份感知偏见（根据来源模型而非回答质量打分），该偏见尚未被充分测量和纠正。DeepSeek R1超越OpenAI o1的未经证实声明导致英伟达损失5890亿美元市值，凸显了该问题的严重性。

Method: 使用七个验证模型（GPT-OSS 120B、Llama 3.3 70B、GLM 5.1、Qwen3 32B、DeepSeek V4 Pro、Mistral Large3、Sarvam M）对三个主模型的58个事实、推理、政治和偏好类问题分别进行匿名和身份披露评分。随后引入基于以太坊兼容账本的区块链commit-reveal协议：第一阶段法官提交分数与盐值的单向哈希，第二阶段在身份披露后验证链上分数，形成防篡改审计轨迹。

Result: 身份披露对事实问题评分影响较小，对压力推理任务有中等影响，对地缘政治敏感话题影响最大。显著结果包括GLM5.1评分+7.00分（p=0.0249）和Llama 3.3 70B评分+1.56分（p=0.00），证实了身份感知偏见的存在。

Conclusion: 身份感知偏见在不同任务类型中表现不一，政治敏感话题受影响最大。区块链commit-reveal协议通过将盲评与事后声称分离、创建不可篡改的审计轨迹，有效降低了独立研究者和排行榜运营方的验证负担，提高了LLM评估的可信度和透明度。

Abstract: LLM benchmarks can build an organization's reputation and attract customers, but only when results are transparent and verifiable. Unverified claims that DeepSeek R1 outperformed OpenAI's o1 contributed to market panic on January 27, 2025, when Nvidia lost USD589 billion in market value. Yet vendor benchmarks often depend on an honor system.
